nodes.label: Trail Notes web app
nodes.description: A hiker uses the web app over a mobile data connection.

nodes.label: Edge firewall
nodes.description: The public ingress rule forwards only TCP 443 to the application server. The database has no public ingress rule.

nodes.label: Web server and reverse proxy
nodes.description: Terminates TLS, serves web assets, and forwards note API requests to the local API process.

nodes.label: Notes API
nodes.description: Binds to loopback on the application server. This illustrative deployment uses a database adapter.

nodes.label: Notes database
nodes.description: Accepts database traffic from the application server over the private network. The runnable retry fixture uses a separate in-memory store.

relationships.label: Public HTTPS · 443
relationships.description: Loads the web UI and submits notes over the same HTTPS connection path.

relationships.label: Forwards TCP 443
relationships.description: The hardware firewall forwards ingress to the reverse proxy. TLS terminates at the proxy.

relationships.label: API on loopback · 8080
relationships.description: The proxy forwards API requests to 127.0.0.1 on the same physical server.

relationships.label: Private SQL over TLS · 5432
relationships.description: The API uses the private connection between the separate application and database hosts.
